sloka: तत्र राजा गुहो नाम रामस्य आत्म समः सखा ।निषाद जात्यो बलवान् स्थपतिः च इति विश्रुतः ॥२-५०-३३॥
transliteration: tatra rājā guho nāma rāmasya ātma samaḥ sakhā ।niṣāda jātyo balavān sthapatiḥ ca iti viśrutaḥ ॥2-50-33॥

translations.english: There was a king there named Guha, a friend to Rama as his own self, mighty, of the Nishada race, and renowned as a chief.
